title: Quantum Approximate Multi-Objective Optimization in Routing Problems
summary: Multi-objective optimization (MOO) problems are common in logistics, where routing decisions must balance conflicting objectives such as travel distance, delivery time, and operational risk. A recently proposed Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) parameter-transfer strategy solves multi-objective MAX-CUT problems by reusing parameters trained on smaller instances, avoiding costly reoptimization for each scalarized problem.
